findings.claim: Coherent 2023 評估中國鎵、鍺出口限制：預期影響極小或無，理由為庫存充足且可從中國以外取得（2023 資料，未反映 2024-25 升級）
findings.source: Coherent Corp. press release: Coherent Corp. Provides Initial Assessment Of Expected Export Restrictions Of Gallium And Germanium From China
findings.excerpt: Coherent Corp. expects minimal to no impact from the upcoming export restrictions of gallium and germanium from China due to its ample inventories and ability to source these materials outside of China.

findings.claim: 中國對美鎵鍺銻出口禁令於 2025-11-09 暫停，期限至 2026-11-27（Fastmarkets、CIRS 報導）；與 COHR 的直接關聯未見公司揭露
findings.source: Fastmarkets: China suspends export prohibition on gallium, germanium, antimony, superhard materials to US

findings.claim: 產業層面：磷化銦(InP)基板供應集中，中國出口管制使供應不確定（IQE CEO 說法）；未找到 Coherent 自身 InP 採購揭露
findings.source: TheNextWeb: China has 70% of a material AI needs, IQE's CEO warns, Bloomberg reports

findings.claim: Coherent 於 FY2021 關閉中國南京與美國 Tucson 營運，產品與組件移往新加坡與馬來西亞製造（舊年度 10-K，非現況）
